summary: A BofA AI bubble warning, CoreWeave credit stress, and VIX spiking above 22 triggered a four-session, $260B+ risk-off unwind crushing high-multiple AI, cloud, and crypto names (PLTR, SNOW -8%+, MSTR -9.6% with added MSCI removal headwinds, MARA -9.6%). Capital rotated decisively into Defense (RTX +3.7%, LMT +3.6%) and Energy (CVX +2.6%) on Middle East escalation via Yemen missile strikes and a US SPR solicitation, while AAPL held as the lone resilient core-tech name on iPhone demand, Chinese subsidies, and Berkshire support. Core calls — **BUY RTX, LMT, AAPL; SELL PLTR, MSTR** — remained fully intact across all sessions.

Tech's AI/cloud names (DDOG, AMZN) led an oversold bounce on high-conviction upgrades while defense (NOC blowout earnings, RTX/LMT read-across) and small caps benefited from a broadening rally as geopolitical risk premiums eased on US-Iran and Putin-Trump-Xi diplomacy. AAPL was downgraded to WATCH after a sell-the-news reaction to its foldable launch, crypto-adjacent names (MSTR) remain under SELL pressure despite Bitcoin euphoria, and PLTR's extreme valuation keeps its SELL intact notwithstanding the AI rebound. Key open calls: DDOG and AMZN are high-confidence BUYs, RTX and LMT BUYs supported by NOC's $110B backlog, with MSTR SELL and PLTR SELL both maintained.
